# Rust Academy — a DeepSeek Harness plugin

An industry-grade Rust curriculum in the left sidebar of DeepSeek Harness. 32 tracks,
640 focused ch

apters, from `fn main` to production distributed systems — with
exercises, quizzes, quickbytes, prod

uction checklists, reference architectures and
verified links to docs, GitHub repos, papers and conf

ists, reference architectures and
verified links to docs, GitHub repos, papers and conference talks.
## What you get

- **32 tracks / 640 chapters.** Each chapter targets one narrow concept and is
ordered from fundamen

tals to production depth.
- **Hands-on by default.** Every chapter has a goal, focused explanations,

real code,
an exercise with a hint and a worked solution, and a "check yourself" quiz.
- **Industry

material.** Production checklists, named failure modes ("pitfall"),
the crates involved (linked to

docs.rs), and the GitHub repositories behind them.
- **Verified references.** Each chapter links doc

s, GitHub repos, research papers and
YouTube talks where they are genuinely relevant — tagged `Docs`

, `Repo`, `Paper`,
`Video`.
- **Quickbytes.** Short, paste-ready rules of thumb, commands and gotcha

s.
- **12 reference blueprints.** Browse a master–detail view with request flow,
component cards, pr

oduction checklist, related chapters and references.
- **40-group cheatsheet.** 231 copy-ready snipp

ets covering every track — searchable,
with copy and one-click **Try in Playground**.
- **IDE-style

Playground, wired into the course.** A syntax-highlighted editor
with line numbers, auto-indent, Tab

/Shift+Tab, comment toggling, configurable
font size and wrapping, plus Output / Problems / Tests pa

nes, a status bar
(mode, result, timing, cursor, size), keyboard shortcuts
(`Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` run, `C

trl/Cmd+S` format, `Ctrl/Cmd+/` comment), and a
suggestions palette. Every code block has a **Run**

button and every exercise
offers **Open starter in Playground** / **Run solution**; the Playground s

hows
the chapter it came from with a back link. Runs in the official
`play.rust-lang.org` sandbox (r

emote, needs network), or **locally** in a
sandboxed temp workspace when the local runner is enabled

.
Includes a **Clippy lint** pass, **rustfmt formatting**, run-as-**tests** with a
pass/fail summary

, parsed **diagnostics** (severity, error code, location,
compiler suggestions), and an insert-at-cu

rsor **suggestions** palette seeded
with Rust idioms and the current chapter's crates. Ctrl/Cmd+Ente

r runs; load
the current chapter's starter or solution in one click.
- **Progress, search and track

jump.** Per-track and overall completion, full-text

## How it is wired
| Slot | Registration |

| `sidebar.panellist` | `id: rust-academy`, `order: 20`, localized `label` |
| `main` | `key: rust-a

r.panellist` | `id: rust-academy`, `order: 20`, localized `label` |
| `main` | `key: rust-academy` |

The Host half (`index.js`) is a no-op: the panel needs no Host capability. The Client
module embeds

the curriculum as JSON at build time, so there is no fetch, no database
and no filesystem access at

runtime. Styles use only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so
light and dark themes follow the Harness.

UI text is registered in the Client locale
service under the `rust-academy` namespace; display metad

ata lives in `locale/en.json`
with the artwork in `icon.svg`.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness (Desktop or `dsh web`) with a Web GUI.
- No runtime dependencies and no build ste
p for installation: `client.js` is committed.

## Editing the curriculum

Content lives in `src/data/*.mjs` — one module per track, plus `reference.mjs` for the
cheatsheet an

d blueprints. `src/data/index.mjs` lists the track order. `src/app.js` is
the UI template; `build.mj
s` injects the data and writes `client.js`.
